name: continuity_pipe
description: Rotate pipe pieces 90 degrees clockwise per turn until every pipe connects back to the green source.

grid_size.supported: 3x3 through 6x6 grids; benchmark presets use 4x4 for easy and 5x5 for medium/hard.

difficulty_params.active_pipe_count: Benchmark presets: easy=10-13 active pipes, medium=13-17 active pipes, hard=17-23 active pipes.
difficulty_params.junction_count: Benchmark presets keep tree topology with no loops and no four-way junctions while requiring three-way branch junctions: easy=2-3, medium=3-5, hard=5-7.
difficulty_params.solution_steps: The benchmark difficulty presets are determined by oracle solution length plus structure: easy=13-17 rotations, medium=17-23 rotations, hard=23-27 rotations.
difficulty_params.seed: The first per-sample seed defaults to 1 and increments by 1 for each generated row. Each per-sample seed controls active pipe count, pipe positions, source position, and initial rotations; grid_size is controlled by CLI/UI args.
difficulty_params.generation: A connected sparse pipe network is generated over a subset of grid cells, then each non-empty pipe is rotated by random ticks to create a solvable scrambled board.

success_condition: All non-empty pipe cells are connected to the source through matching pipe openings.
